sentences.text:
La.App. No. 110 Of 2021
 Against The Judgment And Decree Dated 30/07/2019 In Lar
No.6 Of 2017 Of Sub Court, Pala
Appellant/Respondent In Lar:
 The State Of Kerala
 Represented By The District Collector,
 Kottayam.

By Adv
 Smt. Rekha C. Nair - Sr. Gp
Respondent/Claimant In Lar:
 Shyla
 W/O. Somaanathan,
 Edathumkunnel (H),
 Thalappalam,
 Erattupetta 686 121.
 By Adv Shri.Georgekutty Mathew

This Land Acquisition Appeal Having Come Up For Orders On
26.09.2025, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following:
 2025:Ker:72456
Laa No.110 Of 2021
 2
The State Of Kerala vs Shyla on 26 September, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113140645/
1

 Judgment
1. The State is the appellant.

An extent of 0.39 Ares of land in Survey No.375/9 of Erattupetta Village was acquired for the development of Ettumanoor - Poonjar highway as per Section 4(1) Notification dated 05.05.2005.
2.

The Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation, fixing land value at Rs.22,009/- per Are,
building value at Rs.1,808/- and value of improvements at Rs.100/-.

3. The claimant filed Application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, claiming the determination of land value as per the judgment of the same court in LAR No.139/2007, which is produced before the Court as Ext.A4.
2025:KER:72456 LAA No.110 OF 2021 4.
The Collector refused to grant enhancement.

On reference, the Reference Court relied on Ext.A4 and fixed the land value at Rs.42,750/- per Are.
5.
I heard the learned Senior Government Pleader, Smt. Rekha C. Nair for the appellant.

The learned Senior Government Pleader pointed out that Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,
mandates that the property acquired and the property involved in the relied judgment should have been acquired under the very same Section 4(1) Notification.

In the present case, the property belonging to the claimant was acquired as per Section 4(1) Notification dated 05.05.2005 and the property involved in Ext.A4 was acquired as per Section 4(1) Notification dated 30.06.2004.

Hence,
the claimant 2025:KER:72456 LAA No.110 OF 2021 cannot claim re-determination of land value under Section 28A on the basis of Ext.A4 judgment.
6. It is seen that the Reference Court fixed the land value at Rs.42,705/- per Are, relying on the land value fixed in Ext.A4 after giving necessary deduction.

As rightly pointed out by the learned Senior Government Pleader, when Section 4(1) Notification with respect to the property acquired from the claimant and Section 4(1) Notification of Ext.A4 land are different, the claimant is not entitled to invoke Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act relying on Ext.A4.
The Collector rightly rejected the Application filed by the claimant under Section 28A.
The Reference Court should not have interfered with the award of the Collector rejecting the 2025:KER:72456 LAA No.110 OF 2021 Section 28A application of the claimant.
The Reference Court acted illegally in relying on Ext.A4 judgment with respect to the land acquired as per another Section 4(1) Notification and fixing the land value after giving deduction.
The impugned judgment is liable to be set aside.
7. Accordingly, the Appeal is allowed, setting aside the impugned judgment and answering the Reference against the claimant.

Sd/-
